declarations.docstring: For the supplied quiver datum with finite free vertex modules, the indicated vertex transform satisfies one of the two auxiliary predicates whenever the original datum satisfies the first.

With a finite indexing type at the chosen vertex and finite free vertex modules, the alternative vertex transform satisfies one of the two auxiliary predicates if the original datum satisfies the first.
An auxiliary proposition attached to a quiver datum over a commutative semiring.
Produces a quiver hom from the first projection of an auxiliary sigma element to the selected vertex.
Produces a quiver hom from the selected vertex to the first projection of an auxiliary sigma element.
Under the given vertex condition, the first projection of every element of the auxiliary sigma type differs from the selected vertex.
Evaluating the auxiliary map after the structure map associated with a sigma element gives the corresponding component of the underlying direct-sum element.
Applying the auxiliary hom-data map to the hom obtained from a sigma element returns that element's second projection.
